name: Texture
lead: A picture drawn in code: `game.texture(w, h)`. Where a texture is taken, a string is a PNG file in the pack instead.

functions.name: pixel
functions.signature: texture:pixel(x: number, y: number, color: Ink)
functions.description: Sets one pixel; (0, 0) is the top left.

functions.name: rect
functions.signature: texture:rect(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink)

functions.name: frame
functions.signature: texture:frame(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, color: Ink)
functions.description: Draws a box's outline, one pixel wide.

functions.name: noise
functions.signature: texture:noise(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, colors: { Ink }, seed: number ?)
functions.description: Paints each pixel in the area one of the colours at random, as for stone, bark or grain.

functions.name: sprite
functions.signature: texture:sprite(x: number, y: number, rows: { string }, inks: { [string]: Ink }, scale: number ?)
functions.description: Draws pixel art from rows of characters, each character painted with its ink, as on a screen.

functions.name: draw
functions.signature: texture:draw(other: Texture, x: number ?, y: number ?)
functions.description: Draws another texture over this one; its see-through pixels are skipped.

functions.name: copy
functions.description: Returns a copy to draw on.

title: Texture type
